title: Counting the Months a Meal-Status Correction Reaches on a Courtesy Rider Permit Fee (Student Transportation Services)
content:
The adjustment months of a Student Transportation Services fee-waiver adjustment are counted by the permit and by the day the status on file in the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account took effect. The last day of the adjustment window is the end date of an assignment in status ended or cancelled, and otherwise the last day of the permit period (May 31, 2027, or December 31, 2026 for a fall semester fee). The permit period's first school day is August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester fee and January 6, 2027 for a spring semester fee.

| Day the status on file took effect, and the permit | Adjustment months |
|---|---|
| after the last day of the adjustment window, any permit | none |
| before the permit period's first school day, any permit | the calendar months from the month of that first school day through the month of the last day of the adjustment window, both included |
| on or after the first school day, on a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | the whole calendar months after the month the status took effect through the month of the last day of the adjustment window, plus the month the status took effect counted as set out below |
| on or after the first school day, on any other permit | the calendar days from the later of the day the status took effect and the start of the fee's span to the last day of the adjustment window, divided by the calendar days of the fee's span, times the months the fee covers |

**The month the status took effect, on a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual).** It counts as one whole month (1) when the status took effect on or before the 10th day of that month, or when the status rests on a household application received in an earlier calendar month; as half a month (0.5) when it took effect on the 11th through the 20th day; and as nothing when it took effect on the 21st day or later. The household application the status rests on is the meal benefit application the student's meal account names, received on the date it was submitted; a status whose meal account names no application rests on none.

The fee's span runs from the later of the period's first school day and the fee's posting day to the period's last day. A count of calendar days from one date to another is the number of days by which the later follows the earlier.

## Worked counts (hypothetical)

| Permit | Status took effect | Last day of the window | Adjustment months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | July 28 | May 31 | August through May: 10 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | November 10 | May 31 | December through May, 6, plus 1: 7 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | November 11 | May 31 | 6, plus 0.5: 6.5 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | November 21, on an application received October 30 | May 31 | 6, plus 1: 7 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | November 21, no earlier application | May 31 | 6 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | March 3 | cancelled, end date February 14 | none |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester), fall fee posted July 20 | October 2 | December 31 | 90 divided by 141, times 5: 3.1915 |
